newsitem.title: USA: Chilton group holds 8.9 pct MK Rail stake.
newsitem.headline: Chilton group holds 8.9 pct MK Rail stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investor Richard Chilton Jr said Tuesday it has acquired an 8.9 percent stake in MK Rail Corp.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $11.82 million for 1,555,702 common shares of MK Rail.
It said the shares were purchased between October 10 and November 25 at prices ranging fromn $6.188 to $7.631 a share.
It said it holds the stake for investment. The group includes partnerships over which Chilton exercises investment discretion, according to the filing.

MK Rail is a Pittsburgh, Pa., based manufacturer and distributor of engineered locomotive parts. MK Rail has previously announced it would change its name to MotivePower Industries Inc beginning January 1 and begin trading under a news stock symbol "MOPO."
